condition_cn: 条件：90分钟常规时间打平；输入包括完整90分钟预测、平局比分分布、淘汰赛证据、常规时间Tail与MAS结论。

points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段时间短且淘汰赛风险偏好下降，仍平是基础高概率分支。
points.rationale_en: Extra time is short and knockout risk appetite falls, so remaining level is a high-probability base branch.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜
points.rationale_cn: France凭借体能、替补或反击效率在加时净胜一球。
points.rationale_en: France wins extra time by one goal through fitness, substitutes, or counterattack efficiency.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜
points.rationale_cn: Paraguay凭借体能、替补或压迫优势在加时净胜一球。
points.rationale_en: Paraguay wins extra time by one goal through fitness, substitutes or pressing advantages.

points.tail_title_cn: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
points.rationale_cn: France在对手压上后连续制造转换机会。
points.rationale_en: France creates repeated transition chances after the opponent pushes up.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时开放 / 双方进球
points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段比赛打开，双方各有一次有效转化。
points.tail_title_en: Open extra time / both teams score
points.rationale_en: The match opens up in extra time, with each side converting one clear chance.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时开放 / 双方进球，体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
points.rationale_cn: France加时领先后仍被对手回应，但最终净胜。
points.tail_title_en: Open extra time / both teams score, Fatigue collapse / extra-time breakthrough
points.rationale_en: France leads in extra time, concedes a response, but still wins the extra-time period.

points.tail_title_cn: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段体能崩溃或开放对攻形成的低频高偏离路径。
points.rationale_en: A low-frequency tail path where fatigue or open extra-time play creates a wider scoring swing.

points.tail_title_cn: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
points.rationale_cn: 加时一球分胜负的补充覆盖路径。
points.rationale_en: A supplementary one-goal extra-time resolution branch.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时开放 / 双方进球
points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段体能崩溃或开放对攻形成的低频高偏离路径。
points.tail_title_en: Open extra time / both teams score
points.rationale_en: A low-frequency tail path where fatigue or open extra-time play creates a wider scoring swing.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时开放 / 双方进球
points.rationale_cn: 双方加时互有进球但仍未分胜负的补充覆盖路径。
points.tail_title_en: Open extra time / both teams score
points.rationale_en: A supplementary extra-time path where both teams score but the match remains level.

points.rationale_cn: 由统一淘汰赛路径分布派生。
points.rationale_en: Derived from the unified knockout path distribution.

tail_focus.label: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜
tail_focus.label_cn: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜
tail_focus.definition_cn: 加时30分钟内通过反击、定位球或替补冲击形成1球胜负。
tail_focus.rationale_cn: France凭借体能、替补或反击效率在加时净胜一球。
tail_focus.definition_en: A one-goal margin in 30 minutes of extra time via counters, set pieces, or substitute impact.
tail_focus.rationale_en: France wins extra time by one goal through fitness, substitutes, or counterattack efficiency.

tail_focus.label: 加时开放 / 双方进球
tail_focus.label_cn: 加时开放 / 双方进球
tail_focus.definition_cn: 加时阶段双方均有进球，比赛从谨慎拖入开放对攻。
tail_focus.rationale_cn: 加时阶段比赛打开，双方各有一次有效转化。
tail_focus.label_en: Open extra time / both teams score
tail_focus.definition_en: Both teams score in extra time, as the match shifts from cautious play into an open exchange.
tail_focus.rationale_en: The match opens up in extra time, with each side converting one clear chance.

tail_focus.label: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
tail_focus.label_cn: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
tail_focus.definition_cn: 加时净胜至少2球，或总进球达到3球以上的一方打穿路径。
tail_focus.rationale_cn: France在对手压上后连续制造转换机会。
tail_focus.definition_en: A side wins extra time by at least 2 goals, or breaks through with total goals reaching 3+.
tail_focus.rationale_en: France creates repeated transition chances after the opponent pushes up.

key_factors.impact_cn: 如果比赛进入加时，起点就是低风险平局状态。高温、疲劳和淘汰赛压力都让0-0加时分支成立。
key_factors.impact_en: If the match reaches extra time, the starting point is a low-risk draw state. Heat, fatigue and knockout pressure all make a 0-0 extra-time branch plausible.
key_factors.text_cn: 如果比赛进入加时，起点就是低风险平局状态。高温、疲劳和淘汰赛压力都让0-0加时分支成立。
key_factors.text_en: If the match reaches extra time, the starting point is a low-risk draw state. Heat, fatigue and knockout pressure all make a 0-0 extra-time branch plausible.

key_factors.impact_cn: 法国最清晰的加时胜出路径来自替补深度、新鲜锋线和对疲劳防线的持续冲击。
key_factors.impact_en: France’s clearest extra-time winning path comes from bench depth, fresh forwards and the ability to attack tiring defenders without overcommitting.
key_factors.text_cn: 法国最清晰的加时胜出路径来自替补深度、新鲜锋线和对疲劳防线的持续冲击。
key_factors.text_en: France’s clearest extra-time winning path comes from bench depth, fresh forwards and the ability to attack tiring defenders without overcommitting.

key_factors.impact_cn: 巴拉圭仍有通过定位球、二点球和重启进攻一球偷袭的加时路径，但这是生存分支，不是控制分支。
key_factors.impact_en: Paraguay still retain a one-goal extra-time upset path through set pieces, second balls and pressure after restarts. This is a survival branch, not a control branch.
key_factors.text_cn: 巴拉圭仍有通过定位球、二点球和重启进攻一球偷袭的加时路径，但这是生存分支，不是控制分支。
key_factors.text_en: Paraguay still retain a one-goal extra-time upset path through set pieces, second balls and pressure after restarts. This is a survival branch, not a control branch.

key_factors.impact_cn: 如果巴拉圭被迫压出低位，法国可以攻击其身后空间，因此法国0-1或1-2的加时增量更自然。
key_factors.impact_en: If Paraguay have to push out of their block, France can attack the space behind. This makes France’s 0-1 or 1-2 extra-time increments more natural than an open Paraguay edge.
key_factors.text_cn: 如果巴拉圭被迫压出低位，法国可以攻击其身后空间，因此法国0-1或1-2的加时增量更自然。
key_factors.text_en: If Paraguay have to push out of their block, France can attack the space behind. This makes France’s 0-1 or 1-2 extra-time increments more natural than an open Paraguay edge.

key_factors.impact_cn: 高温会增加疲劳风险并降低后程压迫质量，这有利于阵容更深的一方，但也会抑制比赛彻底打开。
key_factors.impact_en: The expected heat increases fatigue risk and may reduce pressing quality late. That favors deeper squads but also keeps the game from becoming too open.

key_factors.impact_cn: 双方都不想进入点球时可能出现短暂对攻，但主形态仍是风险控制和一球差。
key_factors.impact_en: A two-way extra-time exchange remains possible if both teams avoid penalties, but the dominant shape is still risk control and one-goal margins.
